## Fungoid (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
NE Medium plant (fungus)  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +10  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 18, touch 11, flat-footed 17(+1 Dex, +7 natural)  
**hp** 42 (5d8+20)  
**Fort** +7; **Ref** +2; **Will** +1  
**Immune** plant traits; **Resist** electricity 10  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 slams +8 (1d8+4)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 19, **Dex** 12, **Con** 17, **Int** 4, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 6  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +7; **CMD** 18  
**Feats** Improved Initiative, Weapon Focus (slam), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness.*  
**Skills** Perception +10, Stealth +6 (+14 in swampy or forested areas); **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception, +8 Stealth in swampy or forested areas  
**Languages** Common (understands but cannot speak)  
 
 

**Ecology**

 
**Environment** temperate and warm marshes  
 **Organization** gang (2-4) or cluster (6-10)  
 **Treasure** none
